morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；保留词首 /br/ 辅音组合，不在 b 与 r 之间加入元音；-al 不是此处的马来语后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 粗暴、残忍或凶暴的，尤指行动或行为。
senses.en_definition: Rough, cruel, or violent, especially of an action or behaviour.
senses.ms_definition: Kasar, kejam atau ganas, berkenaan dengan tindakan, perbuatan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: Kamus Dewan 标注 bp，即口语用法；被词典收录不等于适合所有正式场合。不要直接套用英语中表示天气恶劣、工作艰难等全部引申义。[来源：PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=brutal)。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 引述证人描述
dual_scenarios.ms: Saksi menyifatkan serangan itu sebagai 'brutal' dan meminta pihak berkuasa menjalankan siasatan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 证人形容该次袭击“残暴”，并要求有关当局展开调查。
dual_scenarios.en: The witness described the attack as 'brutal' and called on the authorities to investigate.

dual_scenarios.zh: 那段打斗场面也太凶残了吧。
dual_scenarios.en: That fight scene was really brutal.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Adegan gaduh tu brutal sangatlah. Kau dah tengok?
messages.ms_standard: Adegan pergaduhan itu sangat brutal. Adakah awak sudah menontonnya?
messages.zh: 那段打斗场面也太凶残了吧。你看过了吗？
messages.en: That fight scene was really brutal. Have you seen it?

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku tutup mata je masa tu.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, saya hanya menutup mata ketika itu.
messages.zh: 看了，我当时就闭着眼睛。
messages.en: Yeah, I just kept my eyes shut during that part.

etymology.historical_story: The international word brutal belongs to a European word family associated with beasts and cruelty. English records trace it through French and Medieval Latin to forms meaning beastlike. Malay uses the same spelling, but DBP marks its entry as colloquial. Its European ancestry does not make every English figurative meaning an established Malay sense. [English history: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/brutal); [Malay usage: PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=brutal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若认识英语 brutal，就用同形桥梁记忆；马来语先牢牢记住 kasar、kejam、ganas：粗暴、残忍、凶暴。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 语气强烈，直接说某个人 brutal 容易成为严厉指责；描述具体行为通常更清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合朋友聊天、影评和引述。正式公文宜按实际意思选择 kasar、kejam 或 ganas；谈论真实受害事件时，应避免把暴力当作值得炫耀的事。
